description: Nothing to add: the package ships every flow it has under `flows/`, which the adapter reads whole. What this file holds is the refusal of the package's two `Waste` compartments, its 13 black-carbon particle rows its 433 country-specific land rows, and its 5,773 other location-specific rows -- water, and emissions such as `Nitrogen oxides, ES` -- whose name ends in a place. Of the 123 water rows left after those, the 22 that encode a water-stress class or an ECO-COSTS stress indicator rather than a kind of water are refused by decision (#389); the other 101 are read in water-flow-materials.json. The waste rows are extracted like every other compartment and refused here on the record, as AGRIBALYSE's final waste is (#189); the black-carbon rows carry climate factors no plain particle flow has, so they are kept out until black carbon is decided as a substance; the location-specific rows, land included, are left out by decision, the unregionalised rows being kept. `excluded_rows_are_in_the_fetch` is set because the fetch produces these rows on every run, and their removal at load is the ordinary path.
